condition_threshold.filter: resource.type = "k8s_cluster" AND metric.type = "custom.googleapis.com/aggr_space_physical_used_percent" AND metric.labels.aggr != has_substring("aggr0")

documentation.content:
Immediate actions are required to minimize service disruption if critical threshold is breached:
1. Delete Snapshots on non-critical volumes 
2. Delete Volumes or LUNs that are non-essential workloads and that may be restored from off storage copies/
3. Tier inactive data to cloud storage via enabling FabricPool on the aggregate.

Plan to take the following actions soon if warning threshold is breached:
1. Move one or more volumes to a different storage location. Runbok link : https://confluence.ngage.netapp.com/display/COPS/Runbook+-+ONTAP+-+Stamp+Re-balance+for+high+Allocation+or+high+Physical+Utilization
2. Add more storage capacity via shelves
